hooks.hook_text: Congrats on joining Versapay as CFO amid the company’s continued customer momentum.
hooks.rationale: As the new CFO, Glen’s focus will be on scaling financial operations and supporting growth initiatives like the recent European acquisition he helped execute at EasyPark, so highlighting the momentum underscores the strategic financial stewardship he’ll need.
hooks.bridge: Our platform automates manual, reconciliation‑heavy processes for operations teams, freeing up finance leaders like Glen to concentrate on high‑impact growth and acquisition finance rather than tedious data entry.
